name: OAI-PMH LAC
description: provides an OAI-PMH XML feed of Dublin Core metadata for Library and Archives Canada.
project_description:
OAI-PMH LAC supports an OAI-PMH XML feed for Library and Archives Canada (LAC) metadata, refer https://www.canada.ca/en/library-archives/services/heritage/theses/info… . This modules assumes you are using Islandora .

 Features 
 Defines oai_lac metadata mapping and metatags that can be populated using tokens.

 Post-Installation 
 This module offers no direct configuration. Configure via the REST OAI-PMH UI and Metatag UI. See README for details.

 Additional Requirements 
 Assumes REST OAI-PMH and Metatag modules are enabled.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Token, Islandora, Controlled Access Terms.

 History 
 Originally developed for SFU Library's Summit project.
